items.title: What ExxonMobil Stock's Guyana Expansion Means For Shareholders
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings has approved a US$12.5b Longtail development in Guyana and started production at Uaru, its fifth Stabroek block project, adding another large FPSO and around 45 planned subsea wells to an already substantial offshore program.
